role: Hospital Medicine Attending Physician (Internal Medicine Hospitalist)

evidence.quote: basically a nonspecific presentation that could've been urinary, pulmonary, early skin or soft tissue, honestly a handful of things
evidence.explanation: Forming a differential diagnosis from disparate signs requires building a mental model of underlying disease processes, not just retrieving information.

evidence.quote: gram-positive cocci in clusters — which honestly points more toward a skin or line source than urinary
evidence.explanation: Re-interpreting new lab data to revise a diagnostic hypothesis is a core conceptual/diagnostic abstraction task.

evidence.quote: I could've done a more stepwise workup — basic labs, urinalysis, maybe a chest film first, and reserved cross-sectional imaging if something localized. Or waited to see how his vitals trended
evidence.explanation: The participant compares and weighs multiple non-routine courses of action and anticipates consequences before choosing an imaging strategy, which is planning/resolution rather than a scripted step.

evidence.quote: Looking at the three side by side, that third option didn't really buy you anything extra for a stable patient like him, it just added burden
evidence.explanation: Weighing tradeoffs among treatment options to select a course of action for a specific patient constitutes resolution/decision synthesis.

secondary_categories.subcategory: A2.4 Information search, retrieval, gathering, and evaluation

evidence.quote: Pharmacy flagged later that the extended bundle is rarely indicated at this severity level anyway, and when ID called back, they said the standard bundle was reasonable
evidence.explanation: The physician gathers and evaluates input from pharmacy, ID, nursing, and lab results to inform ongoing decisions, a clear information-evaluation activity.

evidence.quote: the finalized urine culture came back with no significant growth, and the blood culture flagged preliminarily as gram-positive cocci in clusters
evidence.explanation: Retrieving and comparing new culture results against the working diagnosis is direct evidence of information search and evaluation.

evidence.quote: Fever, around 38.9, heart rate up around 112, blood pressure a little soft, 98 over 62
evidence.explanation: Interpreting numerical vital signs and lab values (leukocytosis, SIRS criteria) against clinical thresholds requires quantitative reasoning.

evidence.quote: The overnight resident's handoff, and how she presented it verbally at rounds, framed this as "likely urosepsis"... We acknowledged it, but the conversation kept circling back
evidence.explanation: The attending coordinates a multi-person rounds discussion, integrating resident, nursing, pharmacy, and ID input toward a joint clinical decision, indicating coordination of a care team.

evidence.quote: Nursing actually flagged that he was up and walking around and asked whether the catheter was still needed
evidence.explanation: Responding to the patient's evolving clinical needs and to staff prompts about ongoing care reflects attending to a patient's condition, though caring/support language is limited.

not_observed_or_insufficient: A1.1 Strength - no evidence of physical exertion
A1.2 Dexterity - no manual procedures described (e.g., no line placement, exam maneuvers detailed)
A1.3 Navigation - no description of physical movement through space
A3.2 Teaching/coaching - resident presents findings but no explicit instruction/mentoring episode is described
A3.3 Selling and influencing - no persuasion or negotiation episode described
A3.5 Caring - patient's emotional/welfare support not directly depicted, focus is diagnostic/therapeutic decision-making
ambiguities: A2.1 (uncodified visual/auditory processing) is plausible given exam findings (erythema, crepitus, redness at IV site) but the interview reports these as reported facts rather than the participant's own perceptual act, so it was not assigned as a separate category; confidence in exclusion is moderate.

A3.4 vs B2 teamwork: rounds discussion involves both coordinating the discussion and simply collaborating; classified primarily as coordination given the attending's role in synthesizing team input, but teamwork level is also rated high under methods.

evidence.quote: I ordered a CT of the torso pretty much right away, before we even had urinalysis back
evidence.explanation: The physician exercises discretion to deviate from a stepwise workup and order advanced imaging independently, showing latitude over method and sequence.

evidence.quote: I signed off on them as they were configured. Didn't actively shorten the telemetry window or pull the catheter order at that point
evidence.explanation: Discretion exists but was not exercised, showing latitude bounded by default order-set configuration.

evidence.quote: Pharmacy flagged later that the extended bundle is rarely indicated at this severity level anyway, and when ID called back, they said the standard bundle was reasonable
evidence.explanation: Pharmacy and ID review and comment on the physician's choices after the fact, indicating a layer of professional oversight/review.

evidence.quote: Case management mentioned afterward that prolonged catheter use bumps up infection risk and can drag out length of stay
evidence.explanation: Case management monitors and flags deviations from best practice, representing organisational oversight of the physician's orders.

evidence.quote: ED wanted the bed, rounds have a hard start time, and you're juggling four or five other patients too
evidence.explanation: The episode depends heavily on handoffs and input from ED, night team, resident, nursing, pharmacy, ID, and case management, indicating high reliance on collaborative exchange to reach decisions.

evidence.quote: it's a fairly textbook SIRS picture without a clear source yet — common enough
evidence.explanation: The presenting scenario is described as a common, recurring pattern of case the physician regularly manages.

evidence.quote: I pulled up our sepsis order set. It gives you three empiric bundles... Our sepsis order set auto-populates five days of continuous telemetry and continues the indwelling catheter as part of the standard pathway
evidence.explanation: Care follows a prescribed, protocolized order set governing both treatment and monitoring defaults, a clear marker of standardisation.

evidence.quote: a nonspecific presentation that could've been urinary, pulmonary, early skin or soft tissue... the finalized urine culture came back with no significant growth, and the blood culture flagged preliminarily as gram-positive cocci
evidence.explanation: The diagnostic picture is ambiguous and evolves unpredictably as new data arrive, indicating low certainty of the relevant clinical facts.

evidence.quote: it wasn't until a bit later, after we looked at his peripheral IV site and saw some redness there, that we really pivoted and started treating it as a likely catheter-related bacteremia instead
evidence.explanation: The team must adapt its working diagnosis and plan mid-course in response to unexpected culture results and physical findings, showing a high need to respond to unforeseen developments.

tools.role_in_task: Sepsis order set used to select empiric antibiotic bundles and auto-populate monitoring orders (telemetry, catheter)

evidence.quote: I pulled up our sepsis order set. It gives you three empiric bundles
evidence.explanation: This is a specialised clinical decision-support/order-entry system specific to hospital medicine, more specialised than generic office software.

evidence.quote: Our sepsis order set auto-populates five days of continuous telemetry and continues the indwelling catheter as part of the standard pathway
evidence.explanation: The same specialised clinical system governs default monitoring orders, confirming its role as a specialised ICT tool central to the episode.

tools.role_in_task: Electronic health record used for viewing nursing notes, lab results, and imaging results

evidence.quote: Labs showed a mild leukocytosis... no obvious skin findings on the ED note
evidence.explanation: Reviewing charted notes and lab values implies routine use of an electronic record system, consistent with basic ICT use, though the EHR itself is not explicitly named.

task_anchors.task_description: Physician orders CT torso before urinalysis returns, influenced by a prior severe case, despite lack of localizing exam findings
Physician selects the 'standard' empiric antibiotic bundle from three order-set options after comparing severity against bundle scope
Physician signs off on default 5-day telemetry and continued catheter orders without reassessing against improved patient status

task_anchors.location: decision point: morning rounds diagnostic reframing
task_anchors.task_description: Team discusses conflicting culture data and gradually shifts diagnosis from urosepsis to catheter-related bacteremia after IV site exam
